comments.value: Agreed. However, if all photos are in 4K quality, it will take up a lot of hard drive space. So it would be nice to be able to switch between normal and 4K quality with a button on the VR-Camera.

@{5f2da1d422470972dc57e474|full_name}: I would enjoy a minor overhaul of the camera controls, it is sort of unreliable and hard to press the buttons sometimes and even now I am not entirely sure when it lets me press and when not lmao

While not a simple in game option, there is documentation on their website on how to change the screenshot and camera resolution if anyone wants to get it now. some lag when taking higher res screenshots/pictures will occur https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/configuration-file

This has been available for a bit as a config file option! We'll try our best to get it into an in-game option later on.
https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/configuration-file

details: So You've added the 4k screenshot feature which is wonderful, but since I'm in VR I'd love to see it added to the Camera itself since I wanna be posing with my friends instead of leaning over to my computer
title: 4k Camera
